style: Create ONE static illustration asset for a polished small strategy game's equipment selection card, landscape 2:1 composition. Semi-realistic hand-painted miniature game art, clean detailed forms, soft ambient light, restrained olive/teal/brass palette, pale ivory-sage background, excellent legibility at 260 pixels wide. All subjects fully contained in central 80% of frame, strong clear silhouettes, generous negative space. Not flat SVG diagrams, not a UI screenshot. No text, no labels, no numbers, no card border, no logos, no decorative arrows. Depict the equipment's distinguishing behavior visually as one crisp frozen moment. No ground plane shadows or oval base patches.

equipment.rifle: A recognizably mechanical olive steel assault rifle at left firing distinct separated brass/copper pointed physical bullets toward a simple small red steel target on right. Short orange muzzle flash, clearly visible individual metal bullets separated by empty gaps, one spent brass casing near the ejection port. No connected beam, no blue glow. The rifle and discrete bullets are the dominant subject.
equipment.laser: A distinctly futuristic compact teal-and-white laser rifle with a luminous cyan emitter lens and visible blue energy cell at left, firing ONE continuous brilliant cyan beam with a white core all the way to a small red steel target on right. Bright tight energy impact on target, restrained blue bloom. No bullet, no brass cartridge, no shell casing, no orange muzzle fire. Shape must clearly differ from a conventional mechanical rifle.
equipment.sword: A refined steel short sword with a brass guard and dark wrapped grip, in a dramatic diagonal side view. The complete hilt, crossguard and blade are prominent and large. A subtle pale crescent slash arc reaches a small red training target on the right, demonstrating close melee reach. No gun, no projectile.
equipment.blast: An explosive ammunition module with a copper-tipped shell in the foreground; on the right a compact vivid orange fireball with flying sparks and small fragments expands around three tiny red training targets. Dominant visual: radial explosion, not a muzzle flash. No readable warning symbols.
equipment.arc: An electric weapon attachment with a ceramic coil and brass contacts at left, producing jagged branching violet-blue electric arcs that visibly jump to three small red steel targets at right. Clearly forked electrical lightning, not a straight beam.
equipment.burn: An incendiary ammunition canister with copper fittings at left; a projectile has ignited a small persistent patch of richly painted orange and amber flames around a red training target at right. Distinct flame tongues, embers, heat glow; no black smoke obscuring the scene.
equipment.frost: A cryogenic weapon module with frosted metal and a luminous icy blue core at left; crystalline ice spreads around a small red training target on the right, encasing part of it in translucent frost. Clear snowflake-like crystal branching and cold vapor, distinctly different from fire.
equipment.pierce: A single sharp brass kinetic projectile travelling horizontally through three red steel training plates arranged in a row. All three plates have aligned clean puncture holes; fragments and short sparks mark each exit, and the same single bullet continues beyond the last plate. No beam, no branching projectile. Readable one-shot penetration.
equipment.bounce: One polished brass projectile visibly ricochets between three red steel training targets arranged as a triangle. Show one continuous angular zigzag motion trail, with a small bright impact spark at each turn and the physical projectile at the final segment. No parallel beam, no explosion.
equipment.split: A compact weapon attachment at left releases one copper projectile that divides into exactly three smaller projectiles travelling in clearly separated diverging directions toward three red training targets at right. Three bright short trails form a fan, clear single-to-three branching, no decorative diagram arrows.
equipment.return: A compact teal-metal boomerang-like projectile in flight, with a clear curved outward amber trail and a pale teal return trail bending back toward its launch device on left, passing a small red training target on right. Show one projectile and a readable looping return path in a static painted moment. No duplicate weapon.
equipment.homing: A guided projectile with small fins and a glowing teal guidance sensor, curving through the air toward a moving red training target at right. One smooth bent luminous trail follows the missile, target's short red motion ghost indicates sideways displacement. Visually emphasizes correction of course, not a straight beam or multiple missiles.
equipment.linger: A golden energy projectile remains suspended beside a small red training target, forming a compact bright orb with two soft concentric pulse ripples and a few slow sparks. A compact gun attachment at left implies the origin. Focus on the stationary persistent orb, no clock or text.
equipment.trail: A copper projectile travels horizontally past a red steel training target while leaving a clearly continuous sequence of small orange burning patches behind it. Individual flame pools along its recent path, warm embers and restrained smoke. Distinguish the persistent trail from a single explosion.
equipment.delay: An ammunition attachment with a small unnumbered clockwork timing dial and brass gears at left. At right a shell rests near a red training target with a thin glowing fuse, the delayed explosion beginning to bloom behind it. Clock face has hands but no text or numerals. Timing device and pending detonation visually clear.
equipment.lob: A mortar-like barrel at lower left launches a single copper shell along a visibly high parabolic arc over a low neutral stone divider toward a red training target at lower right. A clear golden curved trajectory with shell at apex, mild motion streak, compact impact flare at destination. No straight horizontal beam.

buildings.barracks: Using the reference ONLY for the building design, create a static landscape 2:1 game selection illustration. Preserve the recognizable olive-green arched canvas barracks with ribs and open dark entrance, in a polished detailed hand-painted miniature style. A pair of small unarmed uniformed recruits stand to the right to indicate its output. Pale ivory-sage uniform background. Keep all subjects contained with margins. CRITICAL: remove every shadow beneath the building: no ground shadow, no contact shadow, no gray ellipse, no pedestal, no ground patch, no floor plane. The bottom of the building meets the same clean background as everywhere else. Ambient studio lighting and form shading only. No text, no numbers, no border, no arrows.
buildings.launcherWorks: Using the reference ONLY for the factory architecture, create a static landscape 2:1 game selection illustration. Preserve the recognizable dark pitched-roof workshop, twin brick chimneys and brass crane. Show a small finished mechanical rifle and a distinct cyan-emitter laser rifle to its right as its products. Polished detailed hand-painted miniature art, pale ivory-sage uniform background, all subjects fully contained. CRITICAL: absolutely no ground shadow, contact shadow, gray ellipse, pedestal, floor, or dark patch beneath the building. Ambient form shading only. No text, no numbers, no border, no arrows.
buildings.attachmentWorks: Using the reference ONLY for the factory architecture, create a static landscape 2:1 game selection illustration. Preserve the recognizable dark pitched-roof workshop, twin brick chimneys and brass crane. Show three small weapon modules to its right: a copper explosive shell, a violet electrical coil and an icy blue cryogenic canister, indicating attachment production. Polished hand-painted miniature art, pale ivory-sage uniform background, all subjects fully contained. CRITICAL: absolutely no ground shadow, contact shadow, gray ellipse, pedestal, floor, or dark patch beneath the building. Ambient form shading only. No text, no numbers, no border, no arrows.

Preserve the recognizable timber mine headframe, large wheel and dark stone mine entrance. A neat small stack of golden ingots and coins to the right indicates gold production. Polished detailed hand-painted miniature style, pale ivory-sage uniform background, all subjects fully contained. CRITICAL: absolutely no shadow beneath the building or gold: no ground shadow, no contact shadow, no gray ellipse, no pedestal, floor or ground patch. Ambient form shading only. No text, no numbers, no border, no arrows.
